article.title: Cadena de cláusulas
article.part: Sintaxis discursiva compleja — 복합 담화 통사
article.chapter: Cadenas de cláusulas y suspensión — 절 연쇄와 문장 미완결

claims.summary: Korean clause chaining connects one or more non-final adverbial clauses to a main clause with conjunctive suffixes. The cited study describes time, cause, manner, condition, and circumstance relations, and analyzes longitudinal naturalistic speech and elicited event descriptions.

locator.section: Choi (2020), “Characteristics of the Clause Chaining Construction in Korean” and “Conjunctive Suffixes and Their Functions,” lines 407–429; abstract, lines 389–394.

links.notes: The study explicitly defines non-final adverbial clauses, their conjunctive suffixes and functions, and identifies the longitudinal and elicited datasets.
